statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent syncope and palpitations
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other cardiac arrhythmias
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry (CPT 93229) is medically necessary
The service is to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The service is to correlate symptoms with electrocardiographic findings
The denial reason code is PR-204
